_comment: CANONICAL Sri Lanka import tax rates — single source of truth. Frontend (src/lib/importTaxModel.ts) derives its constants from this file; the backend keeps mirrored constants in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/calculators.py guarded by backend/tests/test_tax_config_parity.py, which fails CI if the two drift. Band upper bounds use null for unbounded. Update 'reviewed' whenever rates are re-verified against the latest gazette.
